scope: Post hoc descriptive diagnostics of existing formal SDS artifacts; no new model fitting, encoder extraction, preprocessing fit, hypothesis selection, or replacement of formal outputs.
privacy: No participant identifiers, per-person predictions, or per-person label rows are emitted.

source_sets.digest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted list of [repository-relative POSIX path, SHA256] pairs, ensure_ascii=False and separators=(',', ':')

protocol_facts.pooling: Arithmetic mean of fifteen separately encoded eight-second vectors; no between-clip order supplied to the prediction head.
protocol_facts.projection: Saved training-person standardization followed by saved PCA8; no PCA fit performed in this diagnostic.
protocol_facts.traditional_features: Ten averaged eight-second shape/spectral descriptors plus five descriptors computed from continuous 120-second PPG: HR mean/SD, interval SD, RMSSD and pulse rate; no ECG validation.

constant_diagnostics.training_median_status: New descriptive calculation using existing training roles only; not a new formal model result or winner-selection criterion.

available_neutral_duration.method: Read fixed stimulus metadata; from earliest fully labelled neutral-window start to earliest neutral video end; do not read model scores to select time.
available_neutral_duration.status: Feasibility from timestamps only; 232-second waveform extraction and evaluation were not performed.

interpretation_limits: Retained feature variance is not retained SDS-predictive information; no predictive utility test of discarded PCA directions was performed.
Fixed folds contain only 36 training, 12 validation and 12 test people; initialization seeds do not create new independent participants or cohort splits.
Early selected MLP epochs and worsening later validation curves are consistent with overfitting/unstable small-sample selection, not proof of a unique causal failure mechanism.
OOF R2 uses the global held-out cohort mean only as a descriptive scoring denominator, not as an available deployment predictor.
Saved best heads were evaluated without fitting; training trajectories were not recorded and cannot be reconstructed from best weights.
Aggregate diagnosis and proposed next controls are exploratory after inspecting existing test results; independent cohorts are required for confirmatory health-increment claims.
The 232-second option is a modest extension of the same experimental neutral period, not repeated multiday health observation.
